about: Frozen interface key list. Every language translates every exact key and every distinct pattern template (patterns with the same template share one translation). Translations live in tools/i18n/<lang>/ui.json: "exact": {key: text}, "patterns": {template: text with {1}..{k} for the slots in order (reordering allowed)}. Order is stable; "where" is an approximate, informational pointer into src/app.html (heuristic, may drift as the app changes); pattern order is semantic (first match wins). "optionalFor" lists languages that may omit a key. Regenerate with build_keys.py; merge engine LL() keys with merge_ll_keys.py.

slotTypes.s: short text (lazy match), e.g. a deck or lesson name
slotTypes.d: text without "·", e.g. a deck name inside a "·"-separated line
